title: MINE: A Training-Free Defense against Indirect Prompt Injection via Mutual Information and Embedding Variance
abstract: arXiv:2611.34188v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Existing defenses against indirect prompt injection in retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) are inherently reactive: prompt-engineering methods are often overridden by the injected instructions, while supervised detectors must be retrained for each new attack style. We propose a different paradigm: defend by maximizing relevance, not by detecting attacks. Our method, MINE, is training-free and attack-agnostic, and it also serves as a query-conditioned reranker. To evaluate defenses under realistic conditions, we introduce LC-Inj-SQuAD, a long-context benchmark with an average of 4,032 words per context. We evaluate on four datasets spanning short-context QA (Inj-SQuAD, Inj-TriviaQA), long-context QA (LC-Inj-SQuAD), and agent tool-call injection (InjecAgent). Across all four, MINE achieves the best accuracy--security trade-off among training-free defenses. It is also the only defense that stays usable against a fully adaptive attacker,

translated_title: MINE：一种基于互信息与嵌入方差的无训练间接提示注入防御方法
translated_abstract: 现有的针对检索增强生成（RAG）中间接提示注入的防御方法本质上是被动式的：提示工程方法经常被注入的指令覆盖，而监督式检测器必须针对每种新攻击方式重新训练。我们提出了一种不同的范式：通过最大化相关性来防御，而不是检测攻击。我们的方法MINE无需训练且不依赖特定攻击类型，同时还可作为基于查询条件重排序器。为了在现实条件下评估防御方法，我们引入了LC-Inj-SQuAD，这是一个平均每个上下文包含4,032个词的长上下文基准测试。我们在四个数据集上进行评估，涵盖短上下文问答、长上下文问答（LC-Inj-SQuAD）以及智能体工具调用注入（InjecAgent）。在所有四个数据集上，MINE在无需训练的防御方法中实现了最佳准确率-安全性权衡。它也是唯一在面对完全自适应攻击者时仍保持有效的防御方法。
tldr: MINE提出了一种基于互信息与嵌入方差的无训练、与攻击类型无关的新防御范式，通过最大化相关性而非检测攻击来抵御RAG中的间接提示注入，并在四个数据集上实现了无需训练防御方法中的最佳准确率-安全性权衡。
en_tdlr: MINE introduces a training-free, attack-agnostic defense paradigm against indirect prompt injection in RAG by maximizing relevance rather than detecting attacks, achieving the best accuracy-security trade-off among training-free defenses across four datasets and remaining effective against fully adaptive attackers.
